tweet.text:
Despite my bullish shitposting and current net long positioning, I’m actually decently bearish HTF.

I think float is likely to increase structurally as boomers become net sellers of equities, while weaker employment and lower participation among Zoomers make it harder for that supply to be absorbed.

More broadly, I think the growing degree of financial markets manipulation and macro intervention ultimately ends poorly (as it has so many times... just takes longer than people expect to play out). Most people probably recognize that faith in the system is deteriorating, but as long as liquidity keeps flowing into AI and asset prices keep going up, there’s little incentive to fight it.

Have been steadily buying physical gold every 2–3 weeks over the last few months as a hedge against some of these longer-term risks. I like owning something that doesn’t depend on the financial system functioning perfectly. And if I’m wrong, I can always just pass it down to my kids one day.

But for now

TRUMP DEMANDS IRAN COMPENSATION IN FUTURE TALKS

President Trump says he has instructed U.S. negotiators to demand compensation from Iran in all future negotiations.

The move comes after Tehran reportedly sought compensation for damage suffered during the five-month conflict.

Trump said Washington’s demands should cover Americans killed or wounded in past Iran-linked conflicts, as well as victims of Iranian government crackdowns.
